Functional Design Document
Fund Rule
5
Functional Specifications
Introduction

Background
PNB is the market leader for unit trust business in Malaysia. PNB’s objective is to provide excellent unit trust services, innovative solutions for their customers and agents as well. The scope of work is to enhance  current .net version of FCIS application to FCIS 14.4.0.0.0 base product with functionalities required for PNB.
Organization of the Document
The first chapter of this document gives an introduction with brief background and organization of the document.  Subsequent chapters cover the details of the actual enhancements.
Acronyms and Abbreviations

Requirements Summary
The enhancements scoped in the document are relating to the Fund Setup and Maintenance that were customized for PNB as part of .net enhancements. The Details are covered in the Traceability Matrix section. Interface requirements and processing related changes will be covered as part of  separate document in upcoming releases The summary of requirements is as below:
Manager’s Box Operations
Period Based units incentive
Employee Provident Fund (EPF)-fund setup

price type setup
New aging policy
Corporate Actions- fund setup
Limit setup
Fund corpus reservation and allocation

SST enabling in Fund rule

Transaction Cancellation and Cooling Off Period

SPG (Skim Potongan Gaji)- fund setup

Multiple Pricing
ADAM50 (1A1M) fund setup
Minimum Age for investing
10 free units at the time of account opening
Financial plan (Product Bundle)

Note: This FS covers only upgrade functionality from Dot.Net to J2EE as well as  new requirements which are not there in Dot.Net but already available as part of J2EE existing functionality,
GAP/New requirements which are not part of this FS, these new Gaps will be discussed separately in detail and cover in different FS.

Period Based units incentive
Requirements Overview
During sales campaign, the customers (new / existing) who invest in ASNB funds are eligible for incentives in the form of units. The free units to be distributed as an incentive can be a percentage of units applied. Therefore a facility is required in the system to define unit incentives. This incentive can be for a specific period.
Existing Functionality

System supports maintenance of Loads from FMGàLoad Maintenance Detail (UTDLOADM) Screen.
Currently system allows to maintain the load either amount based or percentage based in the field  ‘Amount Or Percentage ‘.
Assumptions
The Fee and Commission related functionality and processing changes will be covered as part of separate FDD.
Functional Approach

Maintenance
Existing Field ‘Amount Or Percentage ‘ in the FMGàLoad Maintenance Details (UTDLOADM) screen will be enhanced to add two new options ‘Units’ and ‘Percentage of units’, as detailed below:
If field value Amount Or Percentage is set as Units or Percentage of units, the field value Load Type must be maintained as Incentive.
If field value Amount Or Percentage is set as Units or Percentage of units, and If Load type is maintained as Fee then system will show an error message as “Load type Should not be Fee if  Amount Or Percentage is Units or Percentage of units”
Business is required to maintain this type of loads as date based i.e. under Slab Mode, ‘Mode’ field value should be maintained as Date. Currently there is no validation for this and is operationally controlled. Currently the default value of Mode field is Date itself.

As part of Fund load mapping users are required to map these loads as required with  ‘From entity type’ as F (Fund) and the ‘To entity type’ as U (UH).

Income distribution- fund setup
Requirements Overview

A new Income distribution policy  ‘Bonus’ is required in Corporate action type.
System should have provision to define the reinvestment to other funds at fund level. The fund level set up should override the unit holder level preference, if any.
Income Distribution and bonus entitlements are apportioned in 3 ways:-
UH entitlement
Repayment of the loan and

Fees to ASNB
The above-mentioned loans are different from each other as regards the ratio in which dividend or bonus is apportioned towards UH entitlement and repayment of the loan and the fees to ASNB (PPRT loan only). Further within a fund, the apportionment of bonus and dividend may be done in different ratios.
Existing Functionality
Corporate Actions in FMGà Fund rule (UTDFNDRL)àCorporate action facilitates the definition of the guidelines that will govern the distribution of income derived from the fund by the unit holders that subscribe to the fund. user can define the framework according to which corporate actions such as dividend declaration and processing must be performed for a fund. Through this screen the system can also process multiple distributions of a fund on the same day and process the distribution on the same day.
Currently system support two corporate action types

Cash dividend
Stock dividend
Existing field “Restrict IDS for Unit Holder” in FMGàFund Rule (UTDFNDRL)àCorporate Action-- will be used to enable or disable the UHIDS setup for a fund

Dividend and Bonus Processing on an Early Date
Requirements Overview
Income distribution which is currently getting processed on the last day of the financial year would now be required to be processed around 5 to 6 days prior to end date.

Existing Functionality
Assumptions
The Income distribution functionality and processing changes will be covered as part of separate FDD.
Functional Approach
Maintenance

System will be enhanced to add new field ‘Future Dated Reinvestment Processing’ FMGàFund Rules Detail (UTDFNDRL)àGeneral Operating rules
This Drop down is optional and applicable only for Fixed Price Funds and not applicable for the Variable price funds.
If user chooses Variable Price Fund and try to mark as yes ‘Allow Future Dated Reinvestment Processing’ system will show an error message ‘Allow Future Dated Reinvestment Processing is applicable only for Fixed Price Funds’ and the check box will be unchecked.
In FMGàFund RulesàCorporate action maintenance, user needs to maintain the lead time in order for the system to generate Cash & Bonus regular dividend records in advance. Here Book Closing Lead Time will be considered as number of actual / calendar days and not the working days.
System will take last regular dividend record and will add the applicable frequency into dividend to date to get the next year dividend generation date. Post that system will check whether the derived date falls on holiday. In case if it falls on holiday then system will get the Previous or next work date based on the holiday rule from income distribution, from the derived date system will minus the book closing lead time to get the next year dividend record generation date. And system will get previous or next work date if the derived date falls on holiday and holiday rule will be based on income distribution.

Fund corpus Reservation and Utilization
Requirements Overview
A field to specify the fund unit corpus and validate the availability of units in a fund when placing an inflow transaction

Require system enhancement on sub screen ‘Holding limit for investor and transaction categories’ to capture the limits and units utilized based on transaction category, UH category and Race
Existing Functionality
‘Maximum Registered Units’ field is available in FMGàFund rule (UTDFNDRL)àshare characteristic which allows the user to specify the maximum registered units for the fund. A transaction can be allocated only if it does not breach the maximum registered units specified here or at the investor category level. If breached, system will calculate the balance in the fund at the fund level as well at the investor category level, after considering the effect of the transaction to be allotted. If any of the limits are breached, the transaction will not be allocated and marked as error.
User can amend this field at any time, user can increase or decrease the units and system does not display any message.
Currently in J2EE system allows the user to maintained the holding limit for investor category wise and it allows in units in fund rule under tab share characteristic, system display default investor category as PB and maximum register units same as given in main screen of share characteristic

System allows the user to amend the fund rule and change the rule effective date  either to current application date or future date,
Assumptions
The Allocation related functionality and processing changes will be covered as part of separate FDD.

Maintenance

User can amend the fund rule and allowed to increase the ‘Maximum Registered Units’
System will not allow the user to decrease the ‘Maximum Registered Units’ lesser than units already utilized, if user tries to decrease the ‘Maximum Registered Units’ lesser than units already utilized then system will display the error message as ‘Cannot change fundcorpus to a lesser value than existing units utilized’ if user try save the fund.
System will not allow the user to  save the fund modification if the rule effective date is lesser than or equal to application date

Transaction Cancellation and Cooling Off Period:
Requirements Overview
Cooling-off to be offered to all first time investors in any forward pricing funds, and may be extended to existing variable price funds
Existing Functionality

Currently J2EE system allows the user to maintained the cancellation period in FMGàFund rule (UTDFNDRL)àGeneral operating ruleàTransaction cancellation period, user must maintain the options in the fund rules for processing cancellations of transactions
Transaction Cancellation Period field : User can specify a number of calendar days that represents a period from the date of transaction within which cancellations are allowed.
Transaction Cancellation Allowed flag: User can specify whether cancellation is allowed for the fund. Choose ‘Yes’ if you wish to allow cancellation or else choose ‘No’.
Cancellation Period Calendar Basis: Optional
Select the cancellation period from the drop-down list. The list displays the following values:

Actual Calendar
System Calendar
AMC Calendar
Fund Calendar
Cancellation Price Basis: User can specify the price basis to be followed for cancellations. The price basis could be NAV for a single pricing fund. For other type of funds, the basis could be Bid or Offer Price.

The current market value computation as well as the cancellation amount would depend on the bid / offer / NAV.
The system will consider original Subscription price as cancellation price during allocation. While adding subscription load amounts to redemption proceeds, the system will consider only Fee paid by the unitholder.

If Price is available before the transaction, such funds are called Pre pricing funds and mark field ‘Post priced’ as No, if Price is available after the transaction, such funds are called post pricing funds and mark field ‘Post priced’ as Yes

The field ‘Post Priced?’ will be set as ‘Yes’ in if the Fund to be enabled as Forward Pricing Fund
Existing fields ‘Allocation lag’ in FMGàFund rule (UTDFNDRL)àTransaction processing rulesàPolicies will be used to specify the lag days, For Foreign investment funds (Variable price Forward price funds), the ‘Allocation Lag’ will be maintained as “1” meaning 1 day of Allocation lag, that is T-day NAV is made available in FCIS system on T+1 day.
Example: suppose Allocation lag is maintain as ‘1’ day
Current date is (T) 4-Jan-2021
Transaction captured on (T) 4-Jan-2021

NAV will not be available on (T) 4-Jan-2021 so transaction will be not allocated
On next date (T+1) 5-Jan-2021, NAV will be captured for previous day (T) 4-Jan-2021 and transaction can be allocated on current date (T+1) 5-Jan-2021
The transactions which are captured after cutoff are captured for T+1 day and same are processed on T+2 day after NAV is made available
For forward pricing funds, Price Type will be maintained as ‘Variable’.  Hence, Monthly Minimum Balance (MMB) functionality is not applicable for forward pricing funds.
Certificate Functions will not be used for Forward Pricing Funds.

Multiple Pricing
Requirements Overview

At a specified time during the day, ASNB will forcefully suspend transactions for a brief period and will input / import the new NAV into FCIS from the asset management system.
Once the new NAV is ready, ASNB will then resume transactions. All transactions input henceforth will use the latest NAV for allocation purposes
Existing Functionality
Existing fund Transaction sign-off in FMGà fund Transaction sign-off (UTDTSOFF) allows the user to suspend transactions in one or more funds
Assumptions

Assumption: No need to capture multiple prices in a day but to facilitate a new NAV during the day occasionally. Price for a transaction to go by the latest available price. Transactions already allotted for the day will not be corrected.
The Transaction related functionality and processing changes will be covered as part of separate FDD.
Functional Approach
Maintenance
Existing fund Transaction sign-off in FMGà fund Transaction sign-off (UTDTSOFF) will be used to suspend transactions in one or more funds

All transaction screens on fund selection, the existing validation for transaction will be changed to show a message” Transactions  suspended Temporarily due to Price Change”. Thus the transaction cannot be entered during the period transactions have been suspended for price re-input.
